description: Niveau d'accessibilité des cheminements piétons gauche - Diagnostique accessibilité 2014 Toulouse Métropole is a dataset listed in Data Toulouse Metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Toulouse Métropole. Résultat de l'audit d'accessibilité du territoire métropolitain de 2014, sur l’accessibilité gauche des trottoirs sur l'ensemble de Toulouse métropole. Coverage: Toulouse Métropole. The portal files it under Aménagement. Its keywords are Cheminement piéton, pmr, Passage piéton, mobilier urbain, poussette, mobilité. The portal shows 20,076 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2022-05-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-toulouse-metropole-fr-portal.
